title: UiNode
description: The declared UI schema (platform plan 6.2): a page is a tree of these nodes, rendered natively by React (web shell, PWA) today and by SwiftUI (iPhone, Apple TV) later. Session B step 5 adds List, CardGrid, MediaShelf, DetailPane and SplitView (platform plan 6.2's named generic primitives) alongside v0's Chat-only set; see docs/dev.md's 'A2UI' entry for exactly which pages this session converted to real schema pages and which stayed hand-written React, and why.

source.description: route: the app's own backend route. host: a host.* RPC method (4.9).

stream.description: True when this binding delivers incremental updates (turn.token during a Chat reply, 7.2) rather than one value.

target.description: A route or host.* method. May contain a `{field}` placeholder (a bound list item's own field, substituted per item/per selected item by a list's row_action or batch action).

args.description: String values may contain `{field}` placeholders, resolved the same way as `target`.

prompt.description: May contain `{field}`/`{count}` placeholders, resolved against the same item(s) `on_confirm` will act on.

action.description: Exactly one of the five declared actions (6.2).

condition.description: A simple expression string evaluated against page state; absent means always shown.

message_thread.description: The Chat pattern component (6.2 names Chat as one of the three hardest pages to express; this is the pattern component that resulted, not one of the plan's named generic primitives). Session B step 4 rebuilt Chat on @assistant-ui/react, which owns its own history loading, streaming, thread list and message actions entirely inside React (chatModelAdapter.ts, chatThreadListAdapter.ts) - v0's bind/sender_field/text_field described a generic turn-list interpreter never built (see git history on this file); this node is now just a mount point, the same role `settings_editor` plays for Settings.

settings_editor.description: Mounts the kit's own settings renderer (frontend/src/kit/settings/SettingsRenderer.tsx), which already reads the settings registry generically (docs/SETTINGS.md's 'one definition, the generic renderer') - a second, JSON-authored description of the same data would be a competing source of truth, not a schema page in the sense the other nodes here are. Session B step 7 ('settings as an editor') extends that renderer directly (a tree sidebar, search, scope tabs); this node's own shape never changes.

scope.description: selected: the interpreter loops `action` once per currently-selected item, substituting `{field}` placeholders from that item. all: loops over every currently-loaded item regardless of selection (docs/BACKLOG.md's 'clear-all where the whole list is disposable').

list.description: The kit's List primitive (frontend/src/kit/primitives/List.tsx), bound to one route that returns an array. Content-agnostic like the primitive it wraps: a row shows item_label_field as its title and, when given, item_subtitle_field/item_badge_field underneath - a single-line-per-field template, not a full custom renderItem (a page needing richer per-row layout than that stays hand-written React; docs/plans/session-b-ui.md step 5's recorded decision on People and Privacy).

item_subtitle_field.description: A `{field}` template string (the same substitution as action.call's target/args), not a bare dotted path - lets a row's subtitle combine more than one field ('{category} · {scope}') without a richer per-row template mechanism.

item_badge_field.description: Dotted path to a boolean; true shows a small badge (item_badge_label) next to the subtitle.

card_grid.description: The kit's CardGrid primitive (frontend/src/kit/primitives/CardGrid.tsx). No page uses this yet (platform plan 6.2: Videos/Music, not in this session's scope) - added now for catalog/schema completeness (docs/plans/session-b-ui.md step 5's own agreement test), same minimal single-field-per-card shape as `list`.

media_shelf.description: The kit's MediaShelf primitive (frontend/src/kit/primitives/MediaShelf.tsx). Not used by any page this session builds; added for catalog/schema completeness, same reasoning as `card_grid`.

item_media_field.description: Dotted path to the tile's image/poster URL.

detail_pane.description: The kit's DetailPane primitive (frontend/src/kit/primitives/DetailPane.tsx): the 'one thing, in full' half of a SplitView. Not used by any page this session builds; added for catalog/schema completeness.

split_view.description: The kit's SplitView primitive (frontend/src/kit/primitives/SplitView.tsx). Not used by any page this session builds; added for catalog/schema completeness.

nav_entry.description: One row in the shell's nav (docs/plans/session-b-ui.md step 2, frontend/src/shell/nav.ts). Not part of the root `oneOf` above: a nav entry is never a page-body node a page's `body`/`children` array renders - it describes the shell's own chrome, the same distinction `page` (a route) already draws from `section`/`form` (page content). A package's manifest `contributes.pages` field will emit this shape once packages exist; core's own pages declare it by hand in nav.ts today.

to.description: A route path, matching a `page.id`'s route.
